Haley Rome NP Haley Rome NP SKINSPIRIT - PRESTON ROYAL Haley Rome, RN-BSN, is an expert in facial balancing. With a focus on providing the best treatment mix to achieve facial harmony - including Botox and filler treatments - she strives to help others feel more confident and ready to take on the day. "I truly believe beauty is in the eye of the beholder," she says. "So I don't do cookie cutter treatments - I customize every treatment plan for my patients depending on their desired results and anatomy!" A nursing graduate of Stephen F Austin State University, Haley continues to pursue education, and is currently studying for her MSN-FNP at Texas Woman's University. In her studies and in the clinic, she's learned that home care is just as important to achieving great results from your treatments." Just like your hairdresser tells you not to buy cheap shampoo after spending hundreds with them, don't buy cheap skincare after spending hundreds on filler, Botox, and lasers! It really makes a difference and will prolong your results- advises Haley. In her free time, Haley loves to travel, try new foods, and anything that involves nature or animals. She has a Pomeranian and Persian cat that she loves dearly, and she enjoys visiting family in Texas when she can. SkinSpirit understands that every individual is unique. That's why we offer a menu full of treatment options at our med spa in Dallas, TX, including: Neurotoxins BOTOX®: The timeless solution for smoothing expression lines to achieve a refreshed, natural, and polished look. Dysport: A refined injectable that works quickly to soften the frown lines between your brows. Daxxify: The premier long-lasting option for maintaining a smooth, wrinkle-free appearance with fewer visits. Dermal Fillers Dermal Filler: Gently volumize areas of the face to combat shadows and create a brighter look. Facial Balancing: A sophisticated technique using fillers to subtly enhance your natural features for a harmonious look. Juvéderm: A trusted family of fillers that restores youthful volume and gently softens lines and folds. Restylane: A versatile line of fillers designed to add definition, contour cheeks, and create beautifully natural lips. Sculptra: A unique injectable that stimulates your skin's own collagen to restore volume and firmness gradually. Radiesse: An ideal filler for adding instant structure and lift, while also helping your skin improve over time. Facials Custom Facial: A completely personalized facial treatment designed to address your unique skin concerns for a radiant result. Signature Facial: Our exclusive facial designed to deeply cleanse, hydrate, and leave your skin looking healthy and bright. Power Hour: A complete facial experience in just 60 minutes, perfect for a quick yet effective skin refresh. DiamondGlow®: A next-level treatment that deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and infuses for exceptionally smooth and clear skin. Teen Facial: A gentle, professional facial to help calm and clear adolescent skin while promoting healthy habits. Chemical Peels: A professional peel that lifts away dull, tired skin to reveal a brighter, more polished complexion. Microneedling Microneedling: A minimally invasive solution for achieving a brighter, smoother, more rejuvenated look. With Exosomes: An advanced serum that helps guide your skin's renewal process for more refined, beautiful results. With Growth Factors (AnteAGE MD): A powerful add-on that helps your skin rebuild itself for a firmer, more youthful appearance. With PRP/PRF: Uses your own plasma to naturally boost collagen production and improve your skin's overall health and glow. With HA & Biostimulator: A dual-action boost that provides instant hydration while promoting long-term natural plumpness. Energy-Based Treatments BBL / IPL Photofacial: A sophisticated light treatment that targets and clears sun damage and redness for an even skin tone. RF Microneedling (e.g., Morpheus8): An advanced treatment that uses heat and microneedles to tighten skin and rebuild collagen. Specialty Rejuvenation Kybella: The injectable for reducing unwanted fat under the chin for a more defined and elegant jawline. PDO Threads: A non-surgical lift that provides an immediate, subtle lift while stimulating your body's own new collagen. B12 Injections B12: Quick injection to help sustain energy and clear focus. At SkinSpirit, we offer BOTOX® Cosmetic, Dysport®, and Daxxify® as part of our premium neurotoxin treatment options. Our expert injectors are specially trained to deliver precise results, ensuring you look refreshed and natural, never overdone. Skin becomes wrinkled due to the stress of repeated expression of muscle movement on the skin. We use neurotoxins, like BOTOX® and Dysport®, to relax the movement of the expression muscles so that the skin can rest and rebuild the collagen it lost due to repeated movement. The BOTOX® results in diminished lines and smoother skin. Our skilled injectors understand the precise depth, location, and amount of product needed for optimal results. This expertise ensures that while the targeted muscles relax, you maintain natural movement and expressiveness.
